title: Determine the downstream effect of the CGA009 pairing repair
question: Can the exact released feature-generation path be reproduced for Q6N0W9, and does a controlled replacement change benchmark predictions or conclusions?
increment: The published reassessment establishes sequence identity only; it has not regenerated the replacement embedding or compared downstream predictions. Locate and reproduce the exact model/pooling/folds, or document the precise unavailable dependency. Do not recount the original correction.
why_useful: Distinguishes a metadata repair from a repair that changes a benchmark result and yields a reviewable corrected input path.

title: Test feasible baselines for genuinely unseen motif positions
question: Does the reported reporter-to-biochemical benefit survive stronger training-only baselines when an entire motif position is held out?
increment: The existing motif-mean counterexample is for known motifs in held-enzyme folds. Position holdouts require a different feasible comparator. Preserve signed targets, control normalization, dependence and the information available at deployment. Report all positions as one investigation.
why_useful: Tests the narrower predictive claim that survived the held-enzyme reassessment without leaking measurements of the held-out motif.

title: Determine whether the surviving bounds change a real selection decision
question: Can one defensible choice among released Rubisco candidates be identified that remains justified under available uncertainty and calibration assumptions?
increment: Go beyond repeating C08's form-level hit fractions or adding thresholds. Separate representative versus expanded collection, available individual uncertainty and endpoint comparability. Establish a concrete robust selection decision or a useful identification limit.
why_useful: Tests whether the finite-library inference can guide actual follow-up allocation rather than only describe an aggregate contrast.

title: Evaluate the actual thermal-mechanical objective under a physical stopping rule
question: Can the source model's mechanical objective be independently reproduced under temperature-based termination, and does that alter an existing claimed design choice?
increment: Do not add another warming-rate parameter sweep. Inspect actual upstream mechanics, material laws and stopping rule. A contribution must evaluate a decision under the actual objective or establish a concrete reproducible limitation of that calculation, beyond the known absence of stress calculations in C01-C05.
why_useful: Separates thermal proxy improvements from the mechanical endpoint that motivates staged heating.

title: Identify evidence that separates temperature and assay calibration effects
question: Do released matched measurements identify assay-format and temperature effects separately, and what exact additional comparison would resolve the remaining ambiguity?
increment: The original Q10 and calibration limitations are already disclosed. Seek actual same-construct matched comparisons in primary data, code, subsequent work and specialist discussion; do not promote the elementary confounding argument as a discovery. If no new conclusion is supported, write the exact data gap and discriminating design.
why_useful: Makes the calibration uncertainty actionable with an explicit measurement request and suitable producer candidates.

title: Find the measurement bridge from particle maps to model inputs
question: Do existing public matched organ measurements identify the volumetric particle loading and temperature-dependent heating terms required by the model, or which measurements specifically remain missing?
increment: Known generic heterogeneity is not new. Trace actual maps, units, dry-weight conversions, spatial correspondence, heating calibration and thermal boundary conditions. Either establish a concrete recoverable model-input bridge or produce a precise data gap with a minimum discriminating design and documented producer fit.
why_useful: Determines whether the model can be tested against existing measurements before proposing new laboratory work.
